title: STEW binding
description: Runtime config, not part of a board: binds profiles' model requirements to one local model on one machine. spec/binding.md.

api.description: How the runtime talks to the model server.

endpoint.description: The model server's base URL. SHOULD be loopback.

model.description: The model as the server names it (for example an Ollama tag).

provides.description: What this model offers, measured or as its server reports it; matched against each profile's requires.

hardware.description: The machine, in words, as results are reported against it (for example 'one 16 GB GPU').

options.description: Server options passed through (for example num_ctx, keep_alive).
